about: Decision 14's rules table: a source's license notice, as found and quoted, mapped to its tag (the tags of docs/data.md). A fixed table, not a model's judgment. Anything not matched here, and any notice that is missing, vague or contradicts itself, is CHECK (not used) until DadCraft looks (or hands it to Claude). Decision 7 sits on top: fan MIDI, tabs or rips of copyrighted songs are OUT whatever license their collection carries (ideas only). Rows are tried in order, narrowest first, and the first match wins: ND before NC before SA before plain BY ("CC BY" is inside "CC BY-NC"), and plain copyright last (a CC page also says ©). Matches are whole words, case-insensitive ("MIT" is not "permitted").

tags.SAFE: commercial-safe: may train the phone model (Ouralia); credit in CREDITS.md
tags.NC: PC only (experiments, research, the style judge); models trained with it stay on the PC (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)
tags.OUT: not for training: ideas only, written up in our own words, nothing copied
tags.CHECK: license or source not clear: not read, not used, until DadCraft (or Claude) looks

licenses.why: no derivatives: may be read, not adapted or trained on

licenses.needs: attribution; kept apart from commercial-safe data (decision 7)
attribution, share-alike (style data is CC BY-SA 4.0 already)
attribution; ODbL: a shared database stays ODbL

licenses.why: plain copyright or a closed license: facts and ideas only, in our own words

doubt.site-wide license with 'except where not: CHECK until the part used is checked on its own
doubt.a code license (MIT, Apache) on a collec: OUT for the songs (decision 7); the code is checked on its own
doubt.a portal or list linking to other sets: not a source: each linked set is checked on its own
